import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] mat;
        int size;

        Matrix(int size) {
            this.size = size;
            this.mat = new int[size + 1][size + 1];
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(this.size);
            for (int i = 0; i <= this.size; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= this.size; ++j) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= this.size; ++k) {
                        sum += (long) this.mat[i][k] * other.mat[k][j];
                    }
                    res.mat[i][j] = (int) (sum % MOD);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N = sc.nextLong();
        long K = sc.nextLong();

        int[] digits = new int[70];
        int count = 0;
        while (N > 0) {
            digits[count++] = (int) (N % K);
            N /= K;
        }

        // Initialize matrices and prefix/suffix matrices
        Matrix[][] matrices = new Matrix[(int) Math.max(1, count)][(int) K];
        Matrix[][] prefix_matrices = new Matrix[(int) Math.max(1, count)][(int) K];
        Matrix[][] suffix_matrices = new Matrix[(int) Math.max(1, count)][(int) K];

        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            matrices[0][i] = new Matrix((int) K);
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j) {
                matrices[0][i].mat[j][j] = 1;
                matrices[0][i].mat[j][(int) i] = 1;
            }
            matrices[0][i].size = (int) K;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            prefix_matrices[0][i] = matrices[0][i];
            suffix_matrices[0][i] = matrices[0][i];
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
            prefix_matrices[0][i] = prefix_matrices[0][i - 1].multiply(matrices[0][i]);
        }

        for (int i = (int) K - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
            suffix_matrices[0][i] = matrices[0][i].multiply(suffix_matrices[0][i + 1]);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < count; ++i) {
            matrices[i][0] = suffix_matrices[i - 1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j) {
                matrices[i][j] = suffix_matrices[i - 1][j].multiply(prefix_matrices[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }

            prefix_matrices[i][0] = matrices[i][0];
            suffix_matrices[i][(int) K - 1] = matrices[i][(int) K - 1];

            for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j) {
                prefix_matrices[i][j] = prefix_matrices[i][j - 1].multiply(matrices[i][j]);
            }

            for (int j = (int) K - 2; j >= 0; --j) {
                suffix_matrices[i][j] = matrices[i][j].multiply(suffix_matrices[i][j + 1]);
            }
        }

        Matrix answer = new Matrix((int) K);
        answer.mat[0][(int) K] = 1;
        answer.size = (int) K;

        // Multiply answer by prefix matrix of last digit
        answer = answer.multiply(prefix_matrices[count - 1][digits[count - 1] - 1]);

        int lastDigit = digits[count - 1];
        for (int i = count - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < digits[i]; ++j) {
                answer = answer.multiply(matrices[i][(j + lastDigit) % (int) K]);
            }
            lastDigit += digits[i];
        }

        long totalSum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= (int) K; ++i) {
            totalSum += answer.mat[0][i];
        }

        System.out.println(totalSum % MOD);
        sc.close();
    }
}
